scope: Exact actual Chinese figure cells and final browser pixels. English figure labels and a bounded PDF raster diagnostic. Figure properties, decoded cyclic-window tests, and fixed or finitely enumerated examples only. Original r(6)/r(7) search and historical timing not rerun.

diagram.method: Each Chinese printed cell center was calculated from its strip’s measured top and bottom borders. Median of a 3×3 window; thresholds 150 through 167 all agree on every bit. English labels and raster independently inspected; damaged bit intervals were not used as Chinese-cell values.

englishFigureSource.explicitScope: Image-level diagnostic for the first strip only. Native English raster is irregular, exact agreement of all cells is unverified. No English raster correction inferred.

diagram.nonlocalQualification: Panel (e) is the source example. All 256 vertices and one-bit cyclic adjacency were checked. Its nonlocal property is not independently tested by this figure script.

actualFigurePixels.scope: Current rendered figure only, separate from complete-page proofs

record.scope: Current private proof original footnote links exercised in both widths. This adds no whole-page cases.
